name: v13
architecture: multibucket (p60 gate, calibrated 4-bucket mixture, non60 branch) + per-position fitted direct-auxiliary blend
frame: deadline-anchored: all fixtures in a gameweek share one history snapshot

tuning.protocol: 500 single-seed exploration trials, top 12 re-ranked at 3 seeds; winner picked on the 3-seed mean

evidence.protocol: 3 seeds (42, 7, 2026); keep margin 0.0061, set at the measured seed range 0.0106 / sqrt(3) rather than chosen.
evidence.availability_note: Positive on all three independent windows (A +0.0036, B +0.0107, fresh +0.0057; pooled +0.0064). The gain sits in the all-players cohort, which is what the mechanism predicts: a flag tells you whether a player features, not how he ranks among those who do.

rejected_families.set_pieces: +0.0003 all. Declared taker order is already implied by five windows of scoring history; coverage is only 7-10% of rows.
rejected_families.biographical: +0.0021 all. birth_date is populated on 27% of rows.
rejected_families.crowd: -0.0018 all. Home advantage really does invert in empty stadiums, but rolling team form computed during 2020-21 already encodes it.
rejected_families.travel: -0.0041 all. Looked strong on fold A, reversed on fold B.
rejected_families.F4_congestion: Retained, but on no evidence: it entered v13 at +0.0058 under a margin 5.3x below the seed noise, and re-screening put removal at +0.0010 on discovery and -0.0029 on the fresh window. Coin flip; kept because changing it costs a retrain and buys nothing.
